implementation.title: Account Hub singleton action-grid local-synthetic browser receipt

validation.sourceBinding: The final browser report recorded the same clean product commit, tree, source manifest, and production-build dist snapshot before and after all four cases; this receipt retains the two changed Account Hub source/test hashes.

browserReceipt.environment: local-synthetic production-build browser with same-origin fixtures and no external network used

coverage.assertionContract: Singleton action cards fill their usable section grid; normal desktop security retains exactly two equal tracks; accountant security is a singleton; mobile action grids have no horizontal overflow; the normal Telegram panel remains outside the action grid; the daily navigation does not overlap its action; and profile navigation works through Enter and click.

diagnostics.boundary: These zero counts describe only the four covered local/synthetic scenarios; they do not establish a clean-console or network conclusion beyond this receipt.

limitations: This is a bounded local/synthetic production-build browser receipt, not a complete role-by-route, state, interaction, or environment matrix execution.
It covers only normal and accountant contexts, the two recorded viewports, Account Hub action-grid topology, and the recorded keyboard/click journey.
No raw screenshot, trace, console log, network log, local path, local URL, fixture payload, or user data is retained in this repository receipt.

claimBoundary: This bounded source-bound local/synthetic Account Hub singleton receipt does not alter prior historical receipts, protected-surface freeze, full Stage 8 acceptance, owner aesthetic sign-off, a visual freeze, merge authority, Sites authority, staging authority, or production authority.
retention: Only redacted counts, source revisions, source hashes, dist/report hashes, validation totals, and claim boundaries are retained.
